_note: Diet rules for conditions. Every quote here was copied from the page at its url and is re-checked by `npm run verify:sources`, which fetches each page and matches the quote word for word. Reasons restate the quote and add nothing. Status in the app is "sourced" until a clinician has reviewed the rule.

rules.reason: U.S. dietary guidance recommends adults limit sodium to less than 2,300 mg a day.
rules.quote: the Dietary Guidelines for Americans recommends adults limit sodium intake to less than 2,300 mg per day

rules.reason: People with heart failure may be asked to limit salt to reduce fluid buildup.
rules.quote: You may also be asked to limit the amount of salt and liquids that you drink to reduce fluid buildup.

source.title: Eating Right for Chronic Kidney Disease (NIDDK)

rules.reason: With chronic kidney disease you are advised to watch sodium and agree a limit with your care team.
rules.quote: Be aware of the amount of sodium in the foods and beverages you consume and work with your dietitian or health care professional to determine your sodium limit.

rules.reason: With chronic kidney disease, packaged and processed foods with added phosphorus are ones to limit or avoid.
rules.quote: Limit or avoid packaged and processed foods and drinks that have added phosphorus, such as deli meats, flavored drinks, and other processed foods.

rules.reason: With chronic kidney disease, foods listing potassium chloride are ones to limit.
rules.quote: Limit foods with potassium chloride on the ingredient list.

rules.reason: With diabetes, drinks with little or no added sugar are the ones to choose.
rules.quote: Also try to choose drinks with little or no added sugar

rules.reason: With diabetes you are advised to limit how much alcohol you drink.
rules.quote: You should also limit how much alcohol you drink.

source.title: Eating, Diet, & Nutrition for Celiac Disease (NIDDK)

rules.reason: With celiac disease, foods and drinks that contain gluten are to be identified and avoided.
rules.quote: A registered dietitian can help you learn to identify and avoid foods and drinks that contain gluten when you shop, prepare foods at home, or eat out.

source.title: Eating, Diet, & Nutrition for Lactose Intolerance (NIDDK)

rules.reason: With lactose intolerance you may need to reduce the lactose you eat or drink.
rules.quote: To manage your symptoms, you may need to reduce the amount of lactose you eat or drink.

rules.reason: With cirrhosis you are advised to avoid raw or undercooked shellfish, fish and meat.
rules.quote: Avoid eating raw or undercooked shellfish, fish, and meat, and unpasteurized milk and milk products.

rules.quote: Your chance of developing kidney stones increases when you eat more sodium.

rules.reason: Limiting foods high in saturated fat is advised for cholesterol.

rules.reason: Gout flares can be triggered by alcohol and certain foods.
